notes.pattern_adherence: Mirrors established conventions verbatim: __resetFetchOriginCache mirrors __resetRepoLocks in repo-lock.ts, the WS degradation broadcast mirrors notifyOverlayDegraded's try/catch shape, and fetchOrigin/resolveWorktreeBaseRef are kept as separate functions per design.md Decision 1 to avoid perturbing resolveIntegrationBranch's existing test matrix.
notes.test_coverage: 18 new tests in integration-branch.test.ts (success/failure/non-Error-rejection/TTL-dedup/cross-repo/cached-failure/explicit-bypass/head-fallback parity) plus new rail-isolated-launch.test.ts tests (fetch-fail fallback, WS broadcast, per-launch batch dedup, cross-request TTL dedup). notes.security: git fetch origin is read-only against refs/remotes/origin/* only, never mutates the checked-out branch or working tree; repoDir/baseRepo flows through the same trusted call path as pre-existing git calls in this function (no new untrusted input surface). No new API/toggle introduced. Failure paths degrade gracefully and never block or throw.
notes.architectural_alignment: Implementation matches design.md's four decisions point-for-point: fetch runs once per launch inside the existing withRepoLock critical section immediately before resolveIntegrationBranch (Decision 4), TTL-cache dedup lives in integration-branch.ts keyed by repoDir (Decision 2), degradation surfaces via console.warn + a new project-scoped WS event without touching launchIsolatedRail's Promise<string[]> return shape (Decision 3), and the explicit source is completely bypassed with no git calls (Decision 1). Zero changes to worktree-manager.ts or the explicit path, as scoped.
